quest.title: Eight Locales Over Mountains and Seas: Snowswept Fairytale
quest.description: You agreed to Ioroi's request to "bring Kichiboushi out to train." Your first stop is Dragonspine, which Ioroi once saw on the ocean's far side from atop Mt. Yougou.
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Hero's Wit x2, Mora x20000

dialogues.speaker: Ioroi
dialogues.text: I leave Kichiboushi in your trusty hands. He is quite wise. Once he grows older, I plan to pass my titles of "Bake-Danuki King" and "Protector of the Grove" unto him.

dialogues.speaker: Ioroi
dialogues.text: So, please take good care of him. Make sure he doesn't catch a cold!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, even though we managed to raise that huge pillar on the mountaintop...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: D—Dragonspine is just... super c—cold no matter how many times we come here... Ugh...

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Mmhaha! White Fur weak.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not afraid of the cold, Kichiboushi?

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: It's v—very cold. Very very cold.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Come on! Why'd you call Paimon weak, then?

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: B—But very fun. White everywhere.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: White... Oh, you mean the snow!

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: "Snow"? Things fall from Sacred Sakura... "Sakurafubuki"... Snow?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No, no. Snow is the super cold stuff around Dragonspine.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, but Paimon didn't expect that you knew of sakurafubuki, Kichiboushi. Guess that's the bake-danuki of Inazuma for you, huh.

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Mm! Snow! Cold! So cold!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Kichiboushi seems pretty happy.

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Mountain with snow to be cold? Or the cold mountain has snow?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Um, that's a good question, actually. What do you think snow's actually made of, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm. If that's the case, the Hydro elements must've frozen and become snow because the place is too cold.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: C—Cold. So much snow.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We should probably ask someone knowledgeable like Lisa about this stuff in the future.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Dragonspine really is cold, though. When we were last trying to reach the summit, Paimon was so cold that her brain almost stopped working...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But the view's great, though! Since we can see this place from Mt. Yougou, we could probably see Mt. Yougou from Dragonspine's summit, too!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And Starglow Cavern's really deep, too. Maybe we might find some never-before-seen treasure in there...

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Treasure! Treasure, good thing!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Looks like the two of you will get along well, Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, well, there's no good life or food without treasure! Kichiboushi's pretty smart, huh?

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Kichiboushi, want play in snow!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, don't catch a cold now!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: If you run into any danger...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Just holler "there's treasure"!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? If that's the case, the Cryo elements within the snow must be making this place colder...

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: C—Cold. So much snow.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "Don't get frostbite."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Still, Paimon doubts that Kaeya's that strong.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Mm?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: D—Dragonspine is super c—cold no matter how many times we come here... Ugh...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Dragonspine's freezing, but unlike other places in Mondstadt, the air here is very refreshing. Really good for clearing our heads!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: There's a lot of places here that we haven't been to, too.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #If we've got a chance in the future, {NICKNAME}, we should go further into Dragonspine — we might find some treasure long-buried beneath the ice!

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Treasure! Treasure, good thing!

response.speaker: Player

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Mm?

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Hot, hot! But fun!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, but it was either Gyoubu Koban or Shousei who turned into a torch the previous time. Do you tanuki enjoy turning into torches?

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Become human things, can play with humans.

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Or else, humans not play with Kichiboushi.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Don't you worry, Kichiboushi! {NICKNAME} and Paimon will play with you!

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Yey! Play!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But there's a cliff ahead of us right now. Would you like us to carry you over?

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Kichiboushi, flip-flap, kapow!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Kichiboushi creates what seems to be an airbag.\nUsing its powers of flotation and the chilling winds of Dragonspine, he floats to the other side of the cliff.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Whoa, what in the world was that?

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Mmhahaha! Slow, slow, weak!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Argh, this guy isn't cute at all!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't laugh at people, Kichiboushi.

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Laughing, not good?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, how should we put it? Laughing's good, yeah, but laughing at other people isn't.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's only good if everyone can laugh together.

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: #Understand. Sorry, {F#Aunt}{M#Uncle} Yellow Fur.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: #Also, it's not {F#Aunt}{M#Uncle}. It's {F#Big Sis}{M#Big Bro}.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Paimon's name is Paimon, and {F#Big Sis}{M#Big Bro} Yellow Fur is {NICKNAME}. You've got to remember that, Kichiboushi!

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Difficult to remember. Bothersome, White Fur and Yellow Fur.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, no need to force yourself either.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Still, what was that trick Kichiboushi used? One moment he created that balloon with a "swoosh," and then "swish," he went floating right over. It looked pretty cool!

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Eight tatami Kapow.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What in the world is that? Ugh, Paimon's not really getting Kichiboushi again.

choices.text: That was a bit more comprehensible than "Squelch squelch Lavender Melon"...

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: White Fur and Yellow Fur, not have?

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: White Fur flip-flap, Yellow Fur flip-flap. So White Fur and Yellow Fur, having.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: W—Well, you're not wrong...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It might be a bake-danuki ability of some sort.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Mm. Snow mountain fun! Go, go!

choices.text: That was even harder than "Lavender Melon Kapow"...

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Hehe, Lavender Melon Kapow.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What is that even supposed to mean!?

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Yellow Fur, powerful. Very, very strong!

choices.text: I've beaten one even larger than this.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, right! Did the picture come out okay?

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You show Kichiboushi and Paimon the picture you just took.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: This, just like Kichiboushi. Hehe.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This is you, Kichiboushi.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Mm? Kichiboushi, me. Only one.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, this isn't you, Kichiboushi.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Snow mountain has bake-danuki? But no smell.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um, that's not quite it. Dragonspine doesn't have any bake-danuki. This is just you, Kichiboushi?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (You explain the concept of a photo to Kichiboushi!)

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: So it's artwork! White Fur silly. Mmhaha!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh. This is kinda annoying, but Paimon doesn't know how to refute him either...

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Kichiboushi stop laughing. Only laugh together good.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Grr...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Good Kichiboushi! You get a gold star!

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Gold star! Yey!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mm... Then let's stop here for now. You're tired too, aren't you, Kichiboushi?

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Mm.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That let's go back and report to Ioroi, shall we? He did seem pretty worried about this whole thing.

choices.text: Paimon's gotta eat, so I've gotta hunt.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Now that's just rude!

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Creatures...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Creatures... You mean these Snowboars?

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Sealed?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, no. Just trapped in ice, y'know? Dragonspine is a super cold place, after all.

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Oh. Strange.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hmm, speaking of which, do you wanna take a picture of Kichiboushi here, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good idea.

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Mm?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, well, we never know when you'll come around here again, so it would be nice to leave a memory of your trip! It'll also help us prove to Ioroi that we did take you traveling!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alrighty then! Stay right there, Kichiboushi!

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: White Fur, strange. Okay.

dialogues.speaker: Ioroi
dialogues.text: Ooh, you've returned! Nothing hurt withall? No colds caught? Not hungry, I hope?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, Paimon wouldn't say no to some food...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It went quite smoothly, not to worry.

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Mm! Snow cold, but very fun.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah yes, we've brought a souvenir with us, too!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You show Ioroi the picture of Kichiboushi on Dragonspine.

dialogues.speaker: Ioroi
dialogues.text: Ahhh! Kichiboushi! Why is Kichiboushi sealed upon this vellum?

dialogues.speaker: Ioroi
dialogues.text: Is... Is this a Hell Painting? How comes it into your hands? How?

response.speaker: Ioroi
response.text: Oohhh... How could this be...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, come on, stop picking on Ioroi already. That's a "photo," and it's a kind of drawing. Look over there. Kichiboushi's fine, isn't he?

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Yey!

response.speaker: Ioroi
response.text: Eh? Two Kichiboushis... But how? What magic is this?

response.speaker: Ioroi
response.text: ...Ooh! I understand! It's magic, isn't it? Hahaha, much progress have you made in so short a time, Kichiboushi!

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Mmhaha. Stupid.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh... Let us explain, would you?

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You spend a bit more time explaining how photos work to Ioroi.

response.speaker: Ioroi
response.text: Ah, but am I not the world-renowned king of bake-danuki? Of course I knew what this "Kimera" was! I was merely testing Kichiboushi!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't be ridiculous!

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Stubborn. Mm!

response.speaker: Ioroi
response.text: Ahem. Well, whatever the case, it appears that Kichiboushi's training proceeds most well indeed.

choices.text: Traveling with Kichiboushi's been pretty fun.

response.speaker: Ioroi
response.text: Mm, good, good. Then I leave the rest to you.

response.speaker: Ioroi
response.text: When I was yet a young tanuki, I once traveled to 18 sacred sites, treading the tanuki paths as I went — that was how I became the mighty lord of bake-danuki.

response.speaker: Ioroi
response.text: Kichiboushi presently only has about half of mine stature in those days. So, perhaps eight places shall do for his training regimen.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Feels like it should be nine places, but whatever... Where should we bring Kichiboushi next?

response.speaker: Ioroi
response.text: You are unlike other humans. You treat us tanuki well, as good people should. And you are quite sturdy for humans, too. Kichiboushi will learn much by traveling with you.

response.speaker: Ioroi
response.text: Thus, I shall let you decide where he shall go.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, sounds good! Don't worry, leave this to us! Let Paimon think...

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Go! Go!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... What places should we visit...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mm, we'll talk again once Paimon's figured this all out! For now, Paimon's kinda hungry.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't you worry, Ioroi. Leave Kichiboushi to us!

response.speaker: Ioroi
response.text: That I shall.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But it's also really fun. And we got to revisit places we went to before, too.

choices.text: This is a photo, and it's a kind of drawing.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Exactly. Look, Kichiboushi's just fine.

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Mm! Training is fun!

choices.text: As long as you're having fun.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Yellow Fur very strong. Kapow — big and round thing gone.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That's because I train regularly, you know?

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Mm! Kichiboushi, become strong like Yellow Fur!

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Train, train, and train. Strong-strong!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What do you plan to do once you become stronger, Kichiboushi?

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Get back at Gyoubu Koban, mmhaha!

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Then make Ioroi not stone.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Good luck. As for your training route, just leave it to us.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Mm!

choices.text: Let's have fun then. See you later.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Yey!

talks.objective: Go to Chinju Forest and report back to Ioroi
